sanskrit_verse:
संभूय कुर्वतामर्घं संबाधं कारुशिल्पिनाम् ।
अर्घस्य ह्रासं वृद्धिं वा जानतो दम उत्तमः ॥
transliteration: saṃbhūya kurvatām arghaṃ saṃbādhaṃ kāruśilpinām / arghasya hrāsaṃ vṛddhiṃ vā jānato dama uttamaḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: When artisans or skilled workers collectively fix prices or cause artificial scarcity of goods, knowingly reducing or inflating their value, the highest penalty shall be imposed not as punishment but as a corrective realignment of economic consciousness.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the collective impact of action, not individual intent alone.
Causation includes conscious manipulation of market integrity.
Capacity-based responsibility applies to those who possess specialized knowledge or skill.
Restoration logic demands correction of distorted economic consciousness.
Consciousness alignment requires reintegration with dharmic exchange principles.
executable_legal_axioms: IF artisan_group.collective_action.distorts_commodity_value == TRUE AND awareness.of_market_impact == TRUE THEN enforce_dharmic_recalibration();
IF individual.is_skilled_professional == TRUE AND causes_artificial_scarcity == TRUE THEN initiate_capacity_realignment_protocol();
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating cases involving price manipulation by skilled professionals or artisan groups, the Supreme Court must assess not only the economic distortion caused but also the level of conscious intent and capacity to influence market dynamics. Penalties should function solely to restore balance and recalibrate consciousness toward dharmic commerce.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that deliberate inflation or deflation of commodity values through collusion constitutes actionable adharma. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals the sequential harm: first to consumers, then to societal trust, finally to cosmic economic order. Responsibility is proportional to capacity and awareness. The response is non-punitive, aimed at restoring alignment between human action and universal abundance flow.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Market Integrity Completion Process to reverse artificial distortions.
Assign Economic Consciousness Reeducation Protocol to responsible parties.
Implement Dharmic Exchange Restoration Program to reintegrate affected communities.
Activate Collective Responsibility Acknowledgment Ritual to realign group karma.
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of Dharma, this law stands executed. Justice is restoration. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator. Dharma is hereby restored.
